http-listeners.proxy.otoroshi.io.HttpLis.description: An http listener: an additional http server started by otoroshi on its own port, with its own protocols and tls settings, that routes the traffic like the standard listener. A route can be bound to some listeners through its `bound_listeners`. The server is started when the listener is created, restarted when it changes, stopped when it is disabled or deleted

_loc.description: The tenant (organization) and the teams the http listener belongs to. The default tenant and team when absent

id.description: The unique id of the http listener, the one routes name in their `bound_listeners`

name.description: The display name of the http listener, shown and searched in the list of the http listeners of the backoffice

description.description: A free text describing what the http listener is for, shown in its form of the backoffice
description.example: An exclusive h2 listener for the internal grpc services

config.description: The settings of the server of the listener

metadata.description: Free key/value metadata of the http listener, with string values. The admin api stores the date of the last write of the entity under `created_at` or `updated_at`

tags.description: Free tags of the http listener, to sort and search the listeners

example.name: Private h2 listener
example.description: An exclusive h2 listener for the internal grpc services

HttpListenerConfig.description: The settings of the http server of an http listener: the port and interface it binds to, the protocols it speaks and its tls settings

enabled.description: Whether the server of the listener runs, false when absent

exclusive.description: Whether the listener only serves the routes bound to it through their `bound_listeners`. A listener that is not exclusive also serves the routes bound to no listener. False when absent

tls.description: Whether the listener speaks https, with the certificates of otoroshi, instead of plain http. True when absent

http1.description: Whether the listener speaks http/1.1, true when absent

http2.description: Whether the listener speaks http/2 over tls (negotiated with alpn), true when absent

h2c.description: Whether the listener speaks http/2 in clear text, without tls, false when absent

http3.description: Whether the listener speaks http/3 (quic), on an udp socket of the same port. Only with `tls`. False when absent

port.description: The port the listener binds to, 7890 when absent

exposedPort.description: The port the clients reach the listener on, when it differs from `port` (behind a load balancer, a proxy or a container port mapping). `port` when absent

host.description: The network interface the listener binds to, `0.0.0.0` (every interface) when absent

accessLog.description: Whether the listener writes an access log of the calls it serves, false when absent

clientAuth.description: Whether the tls handshake asks the client for a certificate (mtls): `None` never, `Want` asks for an optional one, `Need` requires one, `Dynamic` follows the client auth of the tls settings of the global configuration. Read without case, `None` when absent or unknown
